policies.heading: Financials
policies.body: STAGING — NOT PRODUCTION ⌘K QS Organization financials Financials How operational events affect financial execution. Tuition Catalog Policies Payments Accounting Simulator Funding Policies are named rules that modify commercial pricing and billing behavior. Commercial products reference them — they do not embed duplicated logic. Prefer names like “Registration Fee Waiver,” not “Registration Fee Policy.” New Policy Discounts & commercial policies Discounts, sibling and employee rules and waivers — what reduces a family's price, who qualifies, and from when. These modify commercial pricing; the execution policies below decide how billing runs. Policies 1 policies Sibling discount (QA specimen) Pricing · Discount 10% off everything · Active · from 2026-01-01 Select a policy Discount, deposit, and billing rules configured for your organization. Financial execution policies How this organisation runs billing: proration, billing cadence, when payment is due, posting review and deposits. These are resolved by charge generation and the charge lifecycle — distinct from the commercial discount rules above. Financial Policies How should the organization handle money rules — proration, fees, refunds, deposits? New policy Read-only Policies are scoped, effective-dated configuration. They are consumed later by resolution and posting, but configuring a policy does not post money. Resolved (org default) What resolves at org scope today. A more specific Location / Service / Rate Plan policy overrides it.
